dependency_boundary: Full transitive/OS dependencies are not prevalidated or prelocked; pip report/freeze and image ID must be captured at native build.

fixture.reset: one nominal deterministic upstream initialization; no jitter or evaluation split
fixture.control: post-pre-roll joint target hold, arm gain request ramp 1 -> 0.5 -> 1; no expert callback or ending

success_boundary: Gain/bias propagation, finite force and state, causal clock/whitelisted raw32D state, contact-capacity and CUDA RGB plumbing. Manual task visibility and load calibration remain separate; no task SR or VLA/RL effect.
not_implemented: N2 Cartesian action decoder and model input normalization
environment force metric calibration and real robot validation
